title: I need help to create a parallel event that can allow the player to save at any time except during a choice on RPG MMV

posts.author: BlazyArt
posts.body:
I'm trying to develop a visual on RPG Maker MV (not the best idea I know) and I wanna make it so that the player can save at almost any time by pressing shift thanks to a parallel event.
I know that, when the player will save during a choice, after the save window has closed the game will simply crash. Can I create a parallel event that allows the player to save at anytime except when choices are displayed? Using a script for example?
I don't know if it's possible with a parallel event specifically, but I know it's possible to do because I took Echo607's game "Third Wheel Player" as a reference. (sorry my english is terrible)

posts.author: spillycat
posts.body:
Unless I’m missing something all you need to do is have a switch turn on right before the choices are displayed.
Then in the parallel event, check for whether the switch is turned off, and if it’s off you can trigger the save menu.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Note that saving during
any
event will cause weirdness for the player, because that's not how RPG Maker is designed to work.
When you load the save game, it will restart whatever event the player was in the middle of.
